scenarios.name: Bull
scenarios.notes: Global productivity super-cycle: strong real growth, healthy inflation, high margins, and supportive valuations.

scenarios.name: Base
scenarios.notes: Decent but not heroic global growth: mid-single-digit nominal EPS and modest valuation mean reversion.

scenarios.name: Bear
scenarios.notes: Stagnation & de-rating: low nominal growth, margin pressure, and higher risk premiums compress multiples.

evidence_for: Global diversification across >9,000 holdings across developed and emerging equity markets.
Ultra-low expense ratio (0.07%) eliminating managerial friction.
evidence_against: High concentration in US megacap technology (~65% US equity weight).
Broad equity risk premium sensitive to global central bank interest rate trajectory.
open_questions: Will ex-US developed and emerging equities begin outperforming US large-cap equities?

predictions.claim: VT annualized 5-year total return matches or exceeds 6.5% benchmark
predictions.notes: Tests global equity risk premium baseline.

decision_journal.situation: VT held as core portfolio risk anchor and beta baseline.
alternatives_rejected: Reallocate to single-stock ideas (rejected: baseline index allocation protects against idiosyncratic failures).

decision_journal.situation: WO8 explicit thesis-intact probability review: set belief_state.thesis_intact_probability = 0.95 (legacy probability preserved separately).
